why_this_tool: Databricks puts the lakehouse, workspaces, compute, Unity Catalog governance and AI features in one account, so a single free trial workspace lets you practise every part of working inside a customer data platform.
alternatives: Snowflake (SQL-first warehouse with virtual warehouses as its compute and its own role hierarchy, less notebook and Spark centred), BigQuery (fully serverless warehouse billed per query, no clusters to size), and self-managed Apache Spark with Delta Lake (the same open engine and table format, runnable free on a laptop, but without the managed workspace or Unity Catalog governance).

setup.do: Sign up for the Databricks free trial from your laptop browser; no local install or GPU is needed, and open source Spark with Delta Lake is the closest fully local substitute if you cannot use a trial.
setup.done_when: You can log in and see the workspace home page with its sidebar.
